title: Introducing Quartzy Connect: A Faster Way to Request Lab Supplies From Anywhere
summary: Quartzy Connect Chrome Extension allows you to add requests to Quartzy from any vendor site.
body_markdown:
At Quartzy, we're always looking for ways to make lab management easier and give researchers more time to focus on what matters most: the science.


We know that finding and requesting lab supplies doesn't always start in Quartzy. Sometimes you're browsing a supplier's website, looking for a specific product, or comparing options before making a purchase. But once you've found what you need, manually copying product details into a Quartzy request adds unnecessary steps to your workflow.


That's why we're excited to introduce Quartzy Connect, our new free Chrome extension that makes it easier than ever to request supplies from any supplier's website. See it in action in the video below!


####


#### Less Copying and Pasting, More Time for Research


With Quartzy Connect, you can create a Quartzy request directly from a supplier's product page, without switching back and forth between tabs.


Simply click the Quartzy Connect extension while browsing a product, and details like the product description, catalog number, and price automatically populate your request.


Here's how Quartzy Connect makes requesting supplies easier:


✅ Save time on every request:


Skip manual data entry and create requests in seconds instead of minutes.


✅ Request from anywhere:


Find products on your preferred supplier websites and add them directly to Quartzy.


✅ Reduce errors:


Automatically capture product details to minimize mistakes from copying and pasting.


✅ Keep everything organized:


Requests flow into Quartzy alongside your other supply requests, keeping your lab's approvals, budgets, and purchasing history in one place.


#### Making Quartzy Work Wherever You Are


Our goal isn't to change the way you find lab supplies. It's to make the process of requesting them faster and easier, wherever your workflow takes you.


Quartzy Connect is available now and free to install from the Chrome Web Store.


Give it a try and spend less time on administrative tasks and more time moving your research forward.


[Get Quartzy Connect for Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/quartzy-connect/dmjaclcflonkdcbiiggakpafnpnnojej)
